simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָגֵעַ (H3023) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָגֵעַ (yâgêaʻ) means tired ; hence (transitive) tiresome First listed occurrence: 2Sam 17 2.

definitions.full: H3023. yagea יָגֵעַ adjective weary, wearisome ; — יָגֵעַ Deut 25:18 weary (|| עָיֵף ); 2Sam 17:2 (|| יָדַיִם רְפֵה ); יְגֵעִים כָּלהַֿדְּבָרִים Eccl 1:8 all things are wearisome (' full of labour ').
